narr: A strong afternoon thunderstorm resulted in flash flooding across portions of Central Harris County.
ev: Roadway flooding occurred along the I-10 Frontage Road and in areas surrounding the Memorial City Mall. Multiple cars were stalled as a result of the floodwaters.
lsr: ROADWAY FLOODING OCCURRED ALONG THE I-10 FRONTAGE ROAD AND IN AREAS SURROUNDING THE MEMORIAL CITY MALL. MULTIPLE CARS WERE STALLED AS A RESULT OF THE FLOODWATERS.
